description: This file defines the CommandResolver enum which provides various static methods for resolving, constructing, and executing commands related to a project named 'openclaw'. It includes functions for locating executables, handling remote SSH connections, managing project paths, and generating command-line instructions for running the openclaw CLI or relay commands across local or remote environments.

methods.name: gatewayEntrypoint
methods.description: Determines the gateway entry point script path within the given root directory by checking for common filenames like 'dist/index.js', 'openclaw.mjs', and 'bin/openclaw.js'.

methods.name: runtimeResolution
methods.description: Resolves the RuntimeResolution object by searching preferred paths.

methods.name: makeRuntimeCommand
methods.description: Constructs a command array to run the specified runtime with the given entrypoint, subcommand, and additional arguments.

methods.name: runtimeErrorCommand
methods.description: Generates a command array that outputs the runtime resolution error message.

methods.name: errorCommand
methods.description: Creates a shell script command to output an error message and exit with code 1.

methods.name: projectRoot
methods.description: Determines the project root directory, optionally based on saved user defaults; defaults to '~/Projects/openclaw' or the home directory.

methods.name: setProjectRoot
methods.description: Saves a specified project root path to user defaults.

methods.name: projectRootPath
methods.description: Returns the path string of the current project root.

methods.name: preferredPaths
methods.description: Generates a list of preferred executable paths including environment PATH, project-specific paths, and system directories, with additional paths inserted in debug mode.

methods.name: findExecutable
methods.description: Searches for an executable file by name within given or preferred paths.

methods.name: openclawExecutable
methods.description: Locates the openclaw executable in the search paths.

methods.name: projectOpenClawExecutable
methods.description: Checks for the project-specific 'node_modules/.bin/openclaw' executable if in debug mode.

methods.name: nodeCliPath
methods.description: Finds the path to the openclaw JavaScript entry file ('openclaw.mjs' or 'bin/openclaw.js') within the project.

methods.name: hasAnyOpenClawInvoker
methods.description: Checks if there is any executable that can invoke openclaw, including the CLI and node.

methods.name: openclawNodeCommand
methods.description: Constructs the command array to run 'openclaw' with a particular subcommand and additional arguments, considering remote SSH execution if configured.

methods.name: openclawCommand
methods.description: Alias for 'openclawNodeCommand' to generate the command for executing 'openclaw'.
